meaning:
ὀχύρωμα, -τος, τό
(ὀχυρόω, to fortify, make firm), [in LXX for מִבְצָר, etc. ;]
a stronghold, fortress (Psa.89:40, Nam.3:12, 14 al.); in LXX and NT, also metaphorically of that in which confidence is placed (Pro.10:29 21:22, al.): 2Co.10:4.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,
